purpose: A task-oriented reference for AI agents creating DNAture graphic design and customer-facing content. This is a curated analysis, not a verbatim transcription, live product catalog, or clinical evidence source.

languages.locale_basis: The brand identifies itself as Costa Rican and the source copy is Spanish. Locale is an editorial implementation choice; a complete regional grammar guide is not specified.

reading_contract.evidence_inheritance: Section-level evidence applies to descendants unless a descendant supplies its own evidence. Source pages are 1-based PDF page positions, not printed folios.

evidence_statuses.brandbook_explicit: Stated in the PDF; wording may be summarized. This establishes what the book says, not independent verification of a claim.
evidence_statuses.visual_observation: Observed in rendered examples; not automatically a mandatory rule.
evidence_statuses.editorial_interpretation: An operational recommendation derived from review; not an approved brandbook rule.
evidence_statuses.project_override: A current user-authorized project decision or repository rule, applicable only within its stated scope; not a statement that the source PDF specifies the same choice.
evidence_statuses.repository_reference: A local resource found during review; existence does not prove brand approval.
evidence_statuses.unresolved: The source is conflicting, incomplete, or insufficient to choose a definitive rule.

reading_contract.null_meaning: Not specified or not established; never substitute a guessed value.
reading_contract.approval_meaning: No new design, product claim, asset, or legal assertion is approved by creating this JSON.

Current exact source swatches are secondary_palette; current website assignments are project_context.current_product_categories. Product-family color_id becomes historical_color_id.

sources.review_method: Compared all 79 rendered pages with the previous edition, extracted searchable text, and inspected revised palette, labels, box and illustration pages at higher resolution.
sources.extraction_limitations: Text extraction includes tiny mockup content and ligature warnings. Relevant specifications were checked visually. Mockup ingredient, nutritional, feeding and registration data are not approved product records.

sources.review_method: Rendered all 79 pages with Poppler, reviewed page contact sheets, read local OCR, and inspected logo geometry and color specification pages at higher resolution.
sources.extraction_limitations: The PDF has no extractable text. OCR was checked against visuals for key specifications. Tiny packaging mockup text and SKU lists are not treated as verified production data. Unspecified geometry, tint percentages, and production dimensions remain unknown.

families.label: Masticables
families.source_role_summary: Mostly hard or dehydrated pieces positioned primarily for chewing and enrichment.
families.publishing_caution: Do not equate this family with Complementos de Masticación or assume every item has the same nutritional role or hardness.

families.label: Recetas Complete
families.source_role_summary: Raw, ground nutritional base described as balanced/complete, with individual complements and supplements discussed by the source.
families.publishing_caution: The source simultaneously calls these complete and calls complements essential; do not infer a clinically complete feeding plan from this overview.

families.label: Recetas de Trucha
families.source_role_summary: Trout-based formulas described as functional or specialist-use alternatives, distinct from Recetas Complete.
families.publishing_caution: Do not assume all trout recipes are complete diets, chicken-free, or suitable for unrestricted daily feeding.

families.label: Complementos de Masticación
families.source_role_summary: Chewing-oriented complements framed as contributing to chewing behavior and the nutritional plan.
families.publishing_caution: Do not prescribe daily chewing items or general safety from a brandbook; suitability is individual and product-specific.

families.label: Suplementos
families.source_role_summary: Small-quantity additions in formats such as powders, tablets, or drops, aimed at specific nutritional purposes.
families.publishing_caution: Ingredients listed in the book are not universal recommendations, doses, or proof of safety for all dogs and cats.

families.label: Recetas Wild
families.source_role_summary: Formulas described as combining ingredients that engage chewing and smell, with an ancestral visual narrative.
families.publishing_caution: Ancestor and Spirit appear in label guidelines; verify current SKU spelling and composition. The portfolio list contains a spelling variant.

families.label: Recetas Cocidas
families.source_role_summary: Cooked formulas described as specialist-use options for dogs not consuming raw food, distinct from Recetas Complete.
families.publishing_caution: The source discusses supplementation and professional oversight; verify current labeling before any use guidance.

families.label: Treats
families.source_role_summary: Mostly dehydrated, single-ingredient rewards used in training and enrichment; mixed products also appear.
families.publishing_caution: Do not turn mostly single-ingredient into an all-products single-protein claim.

families.label: Complementos Nutricionales
families.source_role_summary: Foods added to the nutritional plan for ingredient, nutrient, flavor, and texture variety.
families.publishing_caution: Do not publish the source's universal daily-use, allergy-prevention, or deficiency-prevention claims without verification.

ui_color_policy.usage_balance: Use orange meaningfully beyond eyebrow markers in major journeys. Keep cool/neutral surfaces for most reading and maintain clear action hierarchy. Orange does not permit cards, rounded geometry, or shadows.

contrast_guidance.selection_and_focus: Do not rely on an orange-only indicator on white. Use dark text and an additional clear state cue; retain dark focus outlines on light/orange surfaces and light outlines on dark surfaces.
contrast_guidance.states: Preserve the exact orange; use contrast-tested borders, underlines, or icon changes instead of opacity reductions or unapproved warm shades.

ui_color_policy.effect_on_reference: Use current secondary_palette for exact source swatches; keep historical_category_palette as an archive. The five website category assignments and pairings are in current_product_categories. Exact institutional #FF6A00 remains the brand-orange exception.
ui_color_policy.effect_on_proposal: Follow the current website design system and app/theme.css for brand and category roles. Earlier eyebrow-only orange restrictions and historical nine-family website navigation are superseded.
ui_color_policy.digital_support_color_note: #124563 remains a website dark support color inherited from the earlier design. Its historical Wild category role does not assign it to any of the five current categories.

section_eyebrow.requirement: Use in every new landing-page content section with a descriptive, unnumbered label.
section_eyebrow.contrast: Light tone on dark backgrounds; default dark tone on light backgrounds; use color and lineColor for colored surfaces. On orange, use primary dark text and a dark marker. The default orange marker is one part of the wider brand-orange system.

ui_rules: Reuse shared gutters, container widths, headings, spacing tokens, and form rhythm.
Build mobile first and prevent horizontal overflow.
For inline buttons beside other elements, use icon-only on mobile and icon plus text on desktop, with an accessible name and usable target.
Use individual lucide-react icons for UI; hide decorative icons from assistive technology.
Preserve native semantics, visible focus, keyboard access, and reduced-motion behavior.
Use clear landmarks, heading hierarchy, descriptive links and appropriate image alternatives.
Make strategically important public pages discoverable through crawlable navigation, footer and contextual links.

design_system_reference.guidance: Consult the current website specification and preserve its BRAND/REQUIRED/PROPOSED/VERIFY distinction. Website adaptations do not rewrite the original brandbook.

local_asset_discovery.guidance: Inspect the actual asset before use. Do not assume a legacy file is approved merely because it is already in the repository.

website_font_mapping.loading: Bundled WOFF2 files in app/fonts/ loaded by next/font/local in app/layout.tsx; Latin Extended Manrope loads on demand for the Costa Rican colón sign. No runtime or build-time Google Fonts request.
website_font_mapping.reason: No licensed Avenir Next LT Pro or Gotham Ultra webfont files were found in the repository; both are commercial families. The selected Google Fonts are open-licensed substitutes for website text only, not replacements for supplied logo artwork or brandbook typography.

current_product_categories.note: Five website categories specified by the user. Exact accent swatches come from the current brandbook; their category assignments and accessible pairings are user-authorized website design decisions. These decisions do not recolor approved packaging or imply nutritional roles.
current_product_categories.assignment_rationale: Preserve recognizable warm, red, green and purple category distinctions using exact current swatches. Use lighter amber/orange for identification and dark ink for readable text.

usage.accent: Category identification swatches, decorative rules and category-specific fills. Amber/orange alone must not indicate a functional state on light surfaces.
usage.ink: Category text, prices, functional icons, control boundaries and active underlines on white/cool surfaces.
usage.on_color: Text and icons on a solid category accent fill. Black for Complementos/Deshidratados; white for the other three.
usage.labels: Keep category names visible; color is supplementary. Preserve native focus and selected semantics.
usage.scope: Category hues, including warm ones, are confined to category/product context. Ingredient and species artwork retain their source colors; do not infer category from them.

legacy_family_mapping.status: No automatic migration of product membership from PDF examples.
legacy_family_mapping.rule: Use verified commerce category membership. Recetas Complete, Trucha, Cocidas, Wild, Treats, Masticables and historical complement names are not sufficient to assign an SKU to one of the five categories. Órganos and Deshidratados can describe different facets; do not classify by name or imagery alone.
legacy_family_mapping.unknown_category_behavior: Preserve its source label and use neutral colors until commerce classification is updated.

review_findings.summary: The revised book preserves the core strategy, primary palette, logo and typography direction, while replacing the secondary swatches and revising labels, illustrations, icons and campaign mockups. Some explanatory copy and product data lag behind the artwork; use the explicit project mappings and unresolved conflict records.

strengths.finding: Coherent science-plus-care positioning, supported by archetypes and specific tone guidance.
Concrete authorized/restricted vocabulary makes content easier to govern.
Exact primary and secondary swatches and named font families; website category assignments are a separate project decision.
Distinct photography, engraving, tab and packaging language across many applications.
A measurable 30/30/20/20 content mix with examples.

conflicts.issue: The official tagline and La nutrición comienza en el ADN both appear.
conflicts.working_resolution: Use Nutrición con esencia en el ADN as canonical, explicitly defined on pages 20-21. Preserve the other wording only as a source example.

conflicts.issue: BARF is restricted in the vocabulary but appears in comparative campaign copy.
conflicts.working_resolution: Never use BARF as the brand's category label. Prefer positive physiological-nutrition wording; treating comparative use as a blanket exception is not supported.

conflicts.issue: Page 49 says to remove the animal icon because the window shows the product; p. 50 calls for wolf/wildcat illustrations and p. 54 generalizes engraving. The revised dried-lung label on p. 45 prominently shows a cattle engraving.
conflicts.working_resolution: Unresolved. Retain the confirmed family template; seek a brand-owner decision before claiming a new universal pouch layout.

conflicts.issue: The process descriptor is described as bold on page 49 and regular on page 50.
conflicts.working_resolution: Unresolved. Follow the confirmed production template and keep a clear ingredient/process hierarchy.

conflicts.issue: Treat-pouch guidance centers the top logo, whereas Wild and the all-label summary put it at upper left.
conflicts.working_resolution: Preserve family-specific layouts; do not apply the all-label summary to relocate every logo without confirmation.

conflicts.issue: Page 53 explicitly requires lowercase wild; page 54 broadly says uppercase base names while using wild as its example.
conflicts.working_resolution: For Wild, follow the explicit line-specific lowercase treatment shown in the artwork and page 53.

conflicts.issue: Complete is called balanced/complete, while complements are described as essential. The complete overview also says chicken is the base but lists trout/beef; trout alternatives include chicken-containing names.
conflicts.working_resolution: Treat category names as branding, not clinical adequacy or allergen guarantees. Resolve each SKU against current formulation data.

conflicts.issue: Core voice guidance avoids cold clinical communication, but portfolio sections refer to retaining a clinical tone.
conflicts.working_resolution: Interpret as technical precision with human warmth, not impersonal language.

conflicts.issue: Principal/invertida labels are not fully consistent across examples.
conflicts.working_resolution: Choose by actual artwork color, legibility and approved variants rather than the example label alone.

conflicts.issue: The source palette includes multiple warm colors. The current website permits exact institutional brand orange and assigned identification colors for the five current product categories.
conflicts.working_resolution: Use #FF6A00 actively for brand actions and emphasis. Use the five current category colors only to identify their own categories in catalog and product contexts. Other warm general UI colors remain excluded.

conflicts.issue: The vocabulary rejects empty quality/natural claims, while introductory and packaging copy includes such language.
conflicts.working_resolution: Use precise supported descriptions; do not treat every example sentence as pre-approved public copy.

conflicts.issue: The revised PDF still lists nine legacy families and provides 18 unassigned secondary swatches; it does not define the five current website categories.
conflicts.working_resolution: Apply the user-specified five categories and website assignments. Preserve legacy family vocabulary as source history. Verify SKU membership in commerce data.

conflicts.issue: For #2E7246, the upper RGB label is 46,114,70 but the lower RGB row is 55,66,20, repeated from the preceding dark olive.
conflicts.working_resolution: Use #2E7246 / RGB 46,114,70 for digital work; flag the lower source row for correction.

conflicts.issue: Pollo y res and Pollo y caballo examples repeat chicken-only ingredient/nutrition copy and COMPLETE POLLO headings. The horse formula also carries a COMPLETE POLLO Y RES identifier.
conflicts.working_resolution: Treat these as unverified mockup content. Obtain actual recipe records before publishing ingredients, nutrition, claims or labels; do not propagate the apparent copy errors.

conflicts.issue: Revised flat labels show ancestor/spirit in sans serif, while p. 53 still requires script/cursive and some product renders retain the older treatment.
conflicts.working_resolution: Retain supplied confirmed artwork. Record written and visual evidence separately; do not declare a script or sans-serif production rule resolved.

conflicts.issue: The revised box is predominantly white with turquoise animal artwork and the official tagline inside. Page 48 still describes the old turquoise block, wolf/wildcat narrative and previous interior copy.
conflicts.working_resolution: Use current confirmed assets and canonical tagline. Preserve the old description as unresolved source text, not current artwork instructions.

conflicts.issue: New swatches and recipe artwork use amber, orange and burgundy, while prose still describes turquoise/purple dominance and earlier color conventions.
conflicts.working_resolution: Use exact current swatches for digital color. Verify the final recipe/protein color mapping from production assets; do not invent it from contradictory descriptions.

conflicts.issue: The dried-lung front carries a Treats seal while the back describes Suplementos para perros y gatos.
conflicts.working_resolution: Do not classify this product from the mockup. Use its verified current commerce category and approved product record.

Accessibility specification, interactive states, semantic UI colors, responsive grids, motion and component contracts.
Dielines, production sizes, final claims, current registrations and resolution of contradictory label rules.
Publication cadence, grammar/dialect policy, claim review owner and substantiation records.

review_checklist.check: The deliverable applies the correct general-brand or repository-specific rules.
DNAture and the canonical tagline are correct; campaign copy is not presented as the official slogan.
Copy is precise, understandable, empathetic, educational and free of unsupported promises.
Product-family names and restricted-term rules are respected.
Every factual product, health, sustainability or certification claim has appropriate current evidence.
An appropriate supplied logo is used with preserved proportions, clear space, size and contrast.

Colors use exact applicable values; the website combines cool/neutral foundations with meaningful brand-orange participation beyond eyebrow markers, accessible pairings, and no other prohibited warm UI colors.
Typography uses the defined roles and any approved implementation choices; body copy remains readable.
Photographs and engravings match their separate brand roles; assets are suitable for the intended use.
Social, packaging, web or physical-format requirements are applied only within their own scope.
Unresolved source conflicts are not silently converted into official standards.
Digital output preserves semantics, meaningful alternatives, keyboard usability and adequate contrast as required by the project.
Brand rules, visual observations, proposals and product evidence remain distinguishable.
